title: All chat view with merged room feed and room-targeted composer
description:
Add an "All" chat view that merges messages from multiple rooms into one chronological stream, with room filtering tabs at the top and a room-targeted composer at the bottom.

## User-facing behavior

- Opened as a new route/hash item.
- User adds rooms to the All view by searching by name, or by dragging rooms from the sidebar into the view.
- A tab bar at the top of the feed lists the rooms currently added to the All view.
  - Toggling a tab filters which rooms' messages are visible in the merged feed.
- A tab bar right above the composer lists the same rooms.
  - Selecting a tab sets the target room for the next outgoing message.
- Messages are shown in strict chronological order across all visible rooms.
- Consecutive messages from the same room form a visual group; when the room changes, the next message starts a new group.
- Each group has a solid colored vertical ribbon on the left and vertical text showing the room name, styled according to DESIGN.md.
- Room colors are generated (no existing stable colors).
- All existing per-room chat features continue to work inside the All view (reactions, editing, attachments, typing indicators, unread counts, notifications).
- The view rerenders correctly when rooms are added, removed, enabled, or disabled.
- Target scale: ~8 rooms in the All view.

## Technical notes

- The current chat components probably need to be refactored so the message feed and composer can operate in both a single-room context and a multi-room context.
- The merged feed needs to track a list of active rooms, generate colors, group consecutive same-room messages, and recompute groups when the active set changes.
- Composer target room must be kept in state and used when sending messages.

## Design reference

- See `app/DESIGN.md` for colors, typography, tab styling, message blocks, and layout tokens. Sharp, compact, functional UI; teal accents; visible focus outlines; no decorative rounding.
notes: Reduced All view room ribbon border thickness from 0.875rem to 0.5rem and scaled the vertical room label font from 0.6875rem to 0.5rem to fit the narrower ribbon.

title: Alt-click ignore/block for rooms and users
description:
Add a new ignore/block feature: when Alt-clicking a room or user anywhere in the app, show a confirmation prompt. Once confirmed, block them:
- Hide all messages from that room/user from the sidebar.
- Give the user a sepia overlay in the userlist (both global and per-room).
- Hide messages from blocked users in room message lists.
- Add a 'Blocked' section at the bottom of Settings containing rooms and users with layout: [AVATAR/THUMBNAIL][USERNAME][SPACER][X remove]. Alternating white/gray table grid rows.
close_reason: Implemented alt-click ignore/block for users and rooms: confirm-prompt block, sepia userlist overlay, sidebar activity + message hiding, and a Blocked settings table (avatar/thumbnail resolved, stacked under header, alternating rows, X-to-unblock). Fixed capture-phase nav handler swallowing alt-clicks.

title: Chat image click does not expand in React app
description:
In the original vanilla JS application, clicking on an image embedded in a chat/message stream would expand/grow the image in place. After porting to the new React + TypeScript + Vite app, this click-to-expand behavior no longer works.

## Context
Compare behavior against src/ (reference app). The React app is under app/src/. Image rendering likely lives in services/message-list.ts or islands/MessageListView.tsx, with markup handling in markup.ts / MarkupContent.tsx. Need to identify how image clicks were handled in src/messages.js or related files and port the expansion logic.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Clicking an inline chat image in app/src/ expands/grows it to a larger size, matching src/ behavior. 2. Clicking again (or a close mechanism) restores original size. 3. Works for images rendered through markup2.
